info.title: console2svg
info.description: .NET tool launcher for the ConsoleToSvg NativeAOT binary.

options.name: --out
options.description: Output file path (default: output.svg).

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Write SVG to stdout instead of a file.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Output mode (default: image).

options.name: --video
options.description: Output animated SVG (alias for --mode video).

options.name: --width
options.description: Terminal width in characters (default: adjust).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version and exit.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Stop recording after specified seconds (e.g. 5, 0.5).

options.name: --in
options.description: Read an existing asciicast v2 file instead of recording a command.

options.name: --save-cast
options.description: Save captured terminal output as an asciicast v2 file.

options.name: --replay
options.description: Replay recorded keyboard input while running the specified command.

options.name: --replay-save
options.description: Save keyboard input for later replay; requires a command.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose logging; write to path (default: console2svg.log).

options.name: --embed-cast
options.description: Embed the asciicast v2 source in SVG metadata as Base64.

options.name: --embed-replay
options.description: Record and embed keyboard input in SVG metadata as Base64.

options.name: --embed-logs
options.description: Embed verbose diagnostic logs in SVG metadata as Base64.

options.name: --embed-debug
options.description: Enable --embed-cast, --embed-replay, and --embed-logs together.

options.name: --with-command
options.description: Prepend the command line to the output as if typed in a terminal.

options.name: --header
options.description: Override command header text (shown even without -c).

options.name: --prompt
options.description: Prompt prefix for -c (default: $ or # when root).

options.name: --pcmode
options.description: Enable PC (desktop) mode for the selected window style.

options.name: --pc-padding
options.description: Override the outer desktop padding in PC mode (default: 20).

options.name: --opacity
options.description: Background fill opacity (default: 1).

options.name: --theme
options.description: Color theme (default: dark).

options.name: --forecolor
options.description: Override default foreground color.

options.name: --backcolor
options.description: Override the terminal's own background color.

options.name: --padding
options.description: Outer padding in pixels (default: 8).

options.name: --adjust
options.description: SVG text lengthAdjust (default: spacing).

options.name: --font
options.description: CSS font-family for SVG text.

options.name: --fontsize
options.description: Font size in pixels (default: 14).

options.name: --mask
options.description: Mask sensitive strings in the output by replacing them with ***.

options.name: --frame
options.description: Frame index for image mode.

options.name: --time
options.description: Time in seconds for image mode (e.g. --time 3.5).

options.name: --size
options.description: Output image pixel dimensions. Formats:

options.name: --save-frames
options.description: Save each visual frame as a separate static SVG in the given directory.

options.name: --crop-top
options.description: Crop top by px, ch, or text pattern (e.g. 10px, 2ch, sometext, summary:-3).

options.name: --crop-bottom
options.description: Crop bottom by px, ch, or text pattern.

options.name: --crop-right
options.description: Crop right by px or ch.

options.name: --crop-left
options.description: Crop left by px or ch.

options.name: --no-loop
options.description: Disable loop for animated SVG playback in video mode (default: loop).

options.name: --fps
options.description: Max FPS for animated SVG frame sampling (default: 12).

options.name: --sleep
options.description: Wait time after execution completes in video mode (default: 0).

options.name: --fadeout
options.description: Fade-out duration at end of video (default: 0).

options.name: --coalesce-ms
options.description: Coalesce output chunks within the given gap (default: auto; 0 disables).

options.name: --interactive
options.description: Run an interactive shell. F9 starts/stops an animation recording;

options.name: --no-colorenv
options.description: Disable PTY color environment overrides (TERM/COLORTERM/FORCE_COLOR).

options.name: --no-delete-envs
options.description: Keep CI/TF_BUILD in shell execution environment.
